audit_items.proof_trace: RPC-imported data columns bypass the anti-equivocation cache (observed_column_sidecars). Only gossip path calls observe_sidecar (data_column_verification.rs:804). RPC path goes directly to availability_cache without observation, allowing equivocated columns.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker imports column via RPC (unobserved), then gossips conflicting column for same (slot, proposer, index). Second column passes observation check, enabling storage of two contradictory columns and potential fork-choice manipulation.
